title: Price cards for a pretend shop
subject: Mathematics
unit: Spring 1: Money; multiplication and division begins
source: Written for mathematics/y2 lessons 22, 23 (Price cards for a pretend shop)
intro: Cut out the cards and put them on things at home. Take turns to be the shopkeeper: add two prices, and give change from 50p.

questions.q: Buy an apple and a banana. How much altogether?
Buy a pencil and a sticker. How much altogether?
Pay 50p for a ruler. How much change?
Pay 50p for a sharpener. How much change?
